Perfect training treat for our lab. He loves them and they are tiny so I don't worry about over feeding him.

For a sugarless gum this guy is great! I don't like my gum to last so long that my jaw is gonna stiffin up and this lasts just long enough and unlike vitality i can feel the gum in my mouth when i chew it. Even though vitality is also a great gum. My favorite flavor of this gum is the Sweet cherry+Island lime! That one doesn't even taste like sugarless gum!
Really Good for the price. These have 5 different flavorings included Oil, Chili sauce, Soy Sauce etc. Fried Onions and seasoning packet.They taste quite good.

I really liked this product; it was a tad spicy and had fantastic texture (although it is a bit dry). However, it certainly is NOT worth any of the prices asked. Unfortunately, due to this product being a specialty, it makes it difficult to obtain through other means. Overall, great product, disappointing pricing for what you get.
Tried this on my cat who is over 12 years old, who was throwing up her dry food quite a bit - started this food last week, and so far no episodes to clean up off the floor!!  works great.

Really full bodied coffee. Brew this in my Aeropress with superb results. Personally, I don't prefer it as my everyday cup but it satisfies on the days when I want to have a little extra complexity in my coffee.

I liked the Taco Bell Spicy Ranchero Sauce flavor well enough to try this version, and I wasn't disappointed.

The day I got the bottle I immediately opened it and put some in a spoon to taste. It flowed smoothly and had a creamy texture. The jalapeno flavor is prominent without melting your tongue. I didn't detect any off flavors or nasty aftertaste.

I tried it on a roll-up with roast beef and cheese, and it was a nice compliment.

I think it would be a bit too spicy for me to use as a salad dressing (a serving suggestion), but I can see using this on a hamburger, roast beef sandwich, fajitas, baked potato, or a panini. I can also see using this as a dip for veggies or fried appetizers like mushrooms, poppers, or even calamari.

It ain't health food and I don't expect many healthy ingredients, but on the whole this isn't too bad. Like most processed foods, it has too much salt and a lot more chemicals for my liking, but as an occasional condiment it's o.k.

Overall, I'd buy this.

[Update: Within a day of leaving my initial review I received a call from the company regarding my feedback. Best customer service I've ever experienced, and overall great quality product, just not a traditional orgeat.]

I purchased this syrup expecting a normal orgeat syrup. While this is an almond syrup, it does not taste like other orgeat, and does not make nearly as good of a mai tai. It's a good almond syrup, just not what I was expecting.

A friend recommended this brand to us for our new puppy who has some dietary issues. The pieces were too large for our mini schnauzer and he did not seem to react to well to it. We ended up giving it away.

It's not the seller's fault, the mints came on time albeit a few were melted. The product itself has really gone downhill in quality, probably because of the cheap ingredients and fillers used in the chocolate. What a shame.

I really only wanted to purchase a few tins. Unfortunately, at the time I ordered these, it only came in 12 packs. That's a lot of Altoids. But hey, at least I won't have to buy more for quite some time. I wanted to try these because I have issues with nausea and car sickness. Nothing works better for that kind of queasiness than ginger. The Altoids ginger tabs aren't as effective as just straight up ginger tabs, but they have a pleasant spiciness and they get the job done well enough.

These "straws" of diet Snapple taste great (slightly different taste from bottles of same product." They take up much less room than storing a bunch of bottles. Their unique "straw" shape makes then easy to pour into a bottle. My kids love Diet Snapple so it's great to have them. My major complaint and what keeps me from giving this 5 stars is the outrageously expensive costs of shipping. I ordered 8 packages (each package contains 4 boxes and each box contains 4 "straws".) So I ordered enough "straws" to create 128 bottles of Diet Snapple. Each box weighs .45 ounces so all 32 boxes weighed 14.4 oz. The cost of the boxes was $79.92. That's quite reasonable and a good buy. (About 63 cents per bottle which is much less than buying a bottle in the store.) But the cost of shipping this order weighing less than a pound by USPS was a whopping $39.60. That brings the cost of the order to $119.52 and the cost of a bottle from about 63 cents to $1.07. Please, Lynne's Essentials. LOWER THE COST OF SHIPPING! It's much more than the cost of shipping for computer equipment I purchase which is much heavier and ships in 3 days via UPS.Diet Snapple Singles to Go Lemon Tea (4 Sticks in each box) 4 BOXES

I prefer Newman's Special Bold coffee but could not find it when I ordered, so I tried Emeril's. It is similar to Newman's.

As usual, Amazon continues to impress with the delivery service. I live in Sicily (Italy) and have already received my product.....only a 3 day wait.

The syrups are tasty. I rated them down due to their very small sizes----we're talking a small stocking stuffer here. All 3 bottles may (with careful measuring) yeild 8 servings (1 cup, if you please-----not your typical java mug). Java mugs? Maybe 6, if you like your flavoring subtle. I was not impressed with the Chai Latte or any of the Cafe Escapes K-Cups. The flavor would have been good if there wasn't an odd after taste that I can only assume comes from artificial sweetener. When Hurricane Irene hit New York, we lost power but still had a stove that worked. This kit provided a quick and easy and quite cheesy meal. Essentially all you add is browned meat and water. The macaronis are simmered in a seasoned water for a little over ten minutes, then mixed in the browned, drained meat. A packet of velveeta is stirred in the meat and macaroni mixture.

Everyone loved it except me. No I wasn't expecting haute cuisine but I though it could have been less salty and more flavorful. It does taste like a cheeseburger.It is designed to please as opposed to challenge. In fairness, everyone else thought it was absolutely delicious--to the extent that they went out and bought ten boxes. It definitely benefits from serving with a nice crisp salad or jazzing up with some hot peppers, tomatoes and/or salsa.

This is ideal for the busy family, college students or any one looking for a filling, flavorful, easy to prepare meal.

Have been using Saco unsweetened cocoa for several years but when the price even via Amazon skyrocketed I ordered Hershey's, which was less expensive. This Hershey's has a slightly more sharp and somewhat more bitter taste than Saco. I have rated Hershey's at four stars because of that taste comparison, since I prefer Saco - purely a personal preference evaluation.

I agree with other reviewers who say that these are as good or better than non-gluten free pretzels.  And I like that they are lightly salted.

Don't be terrified by the picture of the skull on the can. It didn't over caffeinate me.  As far as taste, I would say it was fair. It was very sweet like most energy drinks are, but it was loaded with B12 and B6 vitamins, which I liked. It gave me energy and got me through my workday. I could concentrate and work easily without feeling over stimulated or jittery.  As far as energy drinks go, it did its job well. I would recommend it for anyone interested in a little boost in his or her day.
This spice used in Caribbean cooking is not easy to find in Texas. It was nice to find it on Amazon.
THIS WAS EXACTLY WHAT I WAS NEEDING. GREAT PRICE, GREAT QUALITY, GREAT SERVICE!!!IT IS GREAT TO KNOW YOU CAN IMAGINE SOMETHING, FIIND IT, AND MAKE IT REAL!~!

I'm not crazy about this product. It's nowhere near as good as the horchata I get at my favorite Mexican restaurants. I think it lacks flavor; it definitely needs more cinnamon. Also, it's quite sweet. It should be poured over a large glass of ice to water it down. I still do enjoy this product somewhat, especially after adding more cinnamon. It's just not ideal, especially because the extra cinnamon doesn't incorporate well. I think I'm going to try blending it with ice and extra cinnamon to see how it turns out.

The Bad: The taste is a version of 'grape,' that is more like bitter, low-class red wine. Tart in an unpleasant way.

It comes in 16-oz cans, with "two servings" per can. Since it's carbonated, you either have to drink the whole can over an extended period, save it and hope it doesn't go flat, share it, or drink it fairly quickly like any normal soda - and get a lot of caffeine and sugar in a pretty short time. Drinks like this should come in smaller cans.

The Good: It will perk you right up, which is the point.

Doesn't give the jitters like some of these drinks tend to. I drank the full can - two servings - but it didn't make my heart palpitate or anything.

I drink several cups of coffee a day, and occasionally drink energy drinks like this as well. Despite my caffeine intake, a caffeinated soda like Diet Coke will still keep me up at night. Notably, this drink did NOT keep me up.

Our family liked Kellogg's crunchy nut cereal very much for that extra crunchy feeling with a coating of nuts on the top and it was not too sweet. It was tasty like the other kellogg's brand cereals even more crunchy than their own cereals. Kids can eat as a morning cereal or as a snack even. I wish they had mixed some other nuts, other flavors or dried nuts to even taste more good. I think anyone would like this cereal. Its worth trying once and see if you like it too.

This is the spicy version of the Amy's chili line, and it is pretty tasty. Soy "beef" makes it look as hearty as "real" chili, and the taste is decent. The beans are perfectly cooked, and the sauce is a great consistency, not as thick as paste or thin as soup broth. This is a good chili to have with grated cheese, onions, and a side of cornbread. The only thing I'd change is make it less sweet. It's like someone thought, "hey, we've gotta keep this from being TOO spicy. What can we do? Oh, yeah! Make it sweeter!" Not my idea of top-notch, but it's not terrible. I add a pinch of salt to mine, and it's perfect.

Enjoy!

I love Pop Chip barbeque chips! They are have a perfect blend and are perfect as a side dish like barbeque beef or pork or just with a good steak!

Think of this like lip balm for hair. I use Redken Structure Wax 17 for Unisex, 1.7 Ounce per the recommendation of my hair stylist. She showed me how to use it and said this little 1.7 oz pot would last forever. I'm still using it months later, so she was right. Now I was curious about this product. It seemed like the Caucasian buyers were scooping this up as if it was a hair mask and wondering why their hair was so greasy. This is a great product for white hair if used in very very small amounts, like lip balm. Just run your fingers over the top of the product and then rub your hands together. Smooth your tresses. It's beautiful. Your hair will stay in place, it will have more gloss and shine. It will be easier to manage. I LOVE this product. Structure wax can only really be used on the ends, but I apply this sparingly with my fingertips (applying only the amount that adheres to my fingertips, not scoops of it!) and my hair looks fantastic. It really does lock the moisture in. If you use structure wax, use this in the same way and you'll be so happy to get 4 times the product for 1/4 the price!

Also, I apply this to freshly blow dried hair or anytime I want to tame my hair, give it more gloss, and add moisture to my dry hair.

We ordered this chocolate to give out as a "door prize" of sorts. Just a nice little thing to say "welcome, glad you are here". The chocolate is good (as Ghirardelli usually is) although it isn't my favorite dark I have ever had, so I gave the chocolate itself 4 stars.

The packaging on the individual wrappers is incredibly tacky though. There are sayings like "A reward for beating my best friend in tennis...again" and "Gets me over the hump between breakfast and lunch" and the worst/least professional in my opinion: "A delicious start to Friday night happy hour." Come on! Are you kidding me? This just seems like something I would expect to find on a Hershey's Kisses wrapper (if it could be done) but not what I expect from a quality company like Ghirardelli. We gave these away last year and they didn't have any "clever messages" on them and the packaging was very tasteful and classy. Unfortunately we can't return and reorder at this point, so we are stuck with these. I will be a bit embarrased to pass these out this year. 0 stars for the packaging.

This seemed like a large amount of peppercorns, but the tellicherry peppers are so full of flavor that I'm using much more pepper than before.  There is no comparison between these and supermarket peppercorns. I'll order these again!
Excellent product if you need to stuff pills down your puppy or dog. Different flavors and most all dogs like them.

This is not listed as lo-cal or diet.. so it was not at all what I was expecting. I would rather have an aspirin dissolve in my mouth. I am returning this to the store. Absolutely terrible.

The first thing that happened when I added this packet to my 12 oz water bottle is that it fizzed and bubbled over! I guess you need to add it to a bottle that has some empty space at the top. Since some of it spilled over, I got a rather diluted taste of the flavor. It was fine, but nothing very special in my opinion. I like the idea that it is good for you, and if you want to add some flavor to your water it is fine, but nothing terrible special or unique.

First impression is to wonder just what the point is for the Moctail line of flavors, are we supposed to use them as drink mix and add alcohol or are they meant as yet another flavor. Either way you save some calories with these zero calorie drink mixes.

My first pass I discovered that adding enough water is pretty important as the flavor can be pretty intense if under diluted. Subsequent trials have yielded better results, and I find them to be pretty refreshing, but nothing like the actual drinks that they are named after as far as taste. I have tasted the Mojito and Margarita flavors and favor the Mojito one for taste, though both are drinkable.

Overall, diversity is a good thing and the Moctail line offers that to the diet drinking public, just don't try to compare them to real cocktails. P-)

I like these crackers.  I'm trying to cut grain out of my diet and I do miss the occasional cracker with cheese.  I miss not having a chip to gather up a little dip while watching a movie.  These crackers meet that need.  They are also low carb if you are trying to cut out excess carbohydrates.  Only reason that I didn't give them a 5-star is the shipping costs make them an expensive treat.  If I can find them locally, I will buy them on a regular basis. If I can't, they will be an occasional treat.

The first time I used the shampoo, my hair felt like it was made out of straw. It literally stripped my hair of all moisture. Reading the bottle, it requires the conditioner to make it a complete package. At first I didn't want to try the two because I was worried it would make my hair worse, but finally I gave in and selected the conditioner as well. I'm very happy that I did! Using the shampoo and conditioner exclusively, I have to say my hair is definitely shinier, softer and healthier than before. I love the pleasing scent of the shampoo and conditioner. Neither are overwhelming. I don't know that I will switch to this shampoo and conditioner exclusively when I run out, but the price and free shipping (with Amazon Prime) certainly makes it appealing. I awarded it three stars because it requires both the shampoo and conditioner to get great results. I like more freedom in selecting my hair care products.

It's not bad, almost even good though not as garlicky or peppery as it should be, but that's a weak statement for a tiny jar that costs $11... before you factor in shipping.

What hurt was that the jar had a huge air bubble in it that took up 1/3rd of the jar.

So $11 plus shipping for about 1.75 oz. Yes, I'll just make it myself thank you.

this almost has a sweet taste right out of the bottle -- so much so that I double checked to make sure it did not have sugar in it (which it did not)

Definately recommend!!

the ice cream was actually a good addition to my son's goodie bags. Even though it was expensive, I believe it was worth it. It was a different item kids would never get at a party. The ice cream itself came well wrapped and sealed. I thought it would be crumbled but it was in good conditions. I personally don't think this tastes good but the kids love it.

This stuff is great for PMS. I drink 2 bags of it at a time and I'll have 3-4 cups of it in a day sometimes. It's very calming and it relieves a lot of PMS symptoms. Like all Yogi teas it has a nice, but interesting flavor to it.
The sugar content is more than I thought it would be, wow, are these sweet. I love sugar, but not that much, in my desserts.

These things are unbelievably delicious and it's so hard to resist the urge to eat only one bag! And the price (at least the current price (of $15/30 pack) is very fair, especially if you get it with Amazon Prime or even Supper Saver Shipping! If you like cookies and you like M&Ms, you WILL NOT be disappointed!

The Nescafe Dolce Gusto Mocha is rich and tasty. The machine puts a real foam on top. Each cup is uniform in taste. At just over $1 per cup it is not expensive if compared to similar drinks purchased at coffee houses.

While it is true that items like these tend to be a little riskier in shipping, mine came in perfect condition, not a broken cookie to be found. However, that's likely luck of the draw when you're talking about a cookie like this that's so easily breakable.

The cookies, though, are delicious. The "thins" in the name scared me a little, wondering if the buttery flavour might be lost in a thinner form because they might have to be cooked longer for crispness. No worries there. This cookie is all Walkers, and the lemon flavour was fantastically distinct without being overbearing or overwhelming. This is perfection for afternoon tea (low tea) or just a lovely cup of tea whenever you choose to take it, and the balance of tart and sweet is great whether you prefer the English tea blends or something like a fragrant jasmine green.

The first thing I noticed about this ultra-red fruit punch liquid drink mix is that it tastes a lot like the cherry Kool-Aid I used to sometimes drink as a kid. It's a good taste, and a little mix in the water goes a long way in terms of attaining the sweetness you want; it doesn't take a lot of mix at all. (Just be sure you blend the mix with water, which I neglected to do the first time I drank it -- way too strong!)

Another plus is that there are some B and C vitamins, electrolytes and "natural caffeine" in the mix, which I'm guessing my Kool-Aid didn't contain back in the day. The mix comes out fast with just a little squeeze, so make sure to get it in the cup. I spilled some of the mix on the kitchen counter the first time I squeezed it out, and it doesn't wipe off easy. I'm guessing this stuff would for sure stain a carpet.

Finally, it would be better if this mix was made with a natural sweetener or even sugar instead of sucralose, but overall it's tasty stuff.

Totally agree that the new packaging is a pain in the neck.  I switched to Enfamil after the Similac recall, and I have half a mind now to return to Similac because of the annoyance of the Enfamil container (plus Enfamil is more expensive!).  I'm sure the formula itself is good stuff (hence the 2 stars), but you wind up losing a fair bit every time you empty the stupid bag into the plastic bin. -- It's POWDER, after all, so it practically clouds up and is messy. I would love to try the disposaKup lids, but they are too spendy. $10.99 for 100 plus $5.98 shipping makes them about .17 cents each. My husband however figured out that the K-Cups fit into the grey or brown My K-Cup tightly the first time and easier after that and the lid screws on tightly and works great. We just leave the little basket out and put in a clean K-Cup also the little filters that are 7.99 for 100 and free shipping with Amazon Prime fit into the My K-Cup filter and put lid on.

I don't make hundreds of rugelach at once so I end up with most of the can unused.  I wish it came in a tube form. I don't really like the flavor because of the sameness although it saves me work.  The simple rugelach dough recipe on the manufacturer's website is excellent.
Full of pulp, which my daughter loves!! I only wish they came in glass and not a can...

I bought 2 boxes of these at the same time thinking I was getting a better deal than buying from the gas station. The first few I ate I didn't have any problems with. Since then, they either have mold or have been so hard that I cannot take a first bite through it (sidenote: I am an avid carnivore). They need to step up their quality control before selling this.

This is it decent gluten-free protein bar , I just wish that it was higher in fiber. but I like that it's under 200 cal and low carb. This is due to the sugar alcohol substitute some people might not be able to tolerate that but I'm fine with that.

Lots of pieces looking like left over treats from the rejects on the manufacturing line. The dogs like them, but they like any treat. One of my dog's digestive system disagrees with some of these treats. I would not recommend them or purchase them again.

Maple sugar candy is the best.  The quality from this company is in line with what I have bought elsewhere.  The candy was not dried out or broken.  This is a much better value than the candy I can buy locally.

This is not a deeply roasted or rich tasting coffee at all. It's very light, with unevenly sized beans -- clearly a blend. Some beans are normal size and some are tiny. The hazelnut aroma and flavor is good, but this coffee is not strong at all -- even using twice as many grounds, I could not get enough coffee flavor from these beans.

People who like very weak coffee will probably love this. People who like Starbucks will not like this one bit.

Purchased this kit when it went on sale for $30.  It didn't work out as the wine stopped fermenting before it finished.  Maybe that is why they had it on sale???  Followed directions exactly and had all the appropriate tools / kept everything clean and sanitary.

It is a nice product with an easy to use sprinkler. I like the cheesy flavour and I would recommend this to anyone who is looking at introducing a cheesy flavour to their meals without the added calories from real cheese. So far i have added it to pasta and its delish!

I use this in a beef style marinade for portobello mushroom fajitas. Turns out great every time! I'm glad to finally have found broth flavorings in granule form, the cubes are such a pain to me. I also bought the chicken and veggie. All have tasted great.

I was expecting a the watermelon flavor to be more like the original jelly belly beans. It had a bit of a acidic taste from the extra stuff they add to make it a sport bean. I shared it with friends who didn't seem to mind the flavor though. I don't think it really gives an extra boost either.
I'm not a huge fan of the minty taste, Some honey covers it well. Otherwise this is a great product.
Item as promised.  Really didn't read the order and was pleasantly surprosed to receive six bottles.  Really good product for someone on the go that is tired of generic tasting veggies.  Recommend.

Okay I admit I purchased this and the Spicy Mayan Chocolate Coffee, mostly because they were/are on sale and because the flavors sounded good. I had this flavor first while my hubby and son jumped into the other.

The coffee is good, and smooth but not as much pecan praline flavor as I had hoped for but still a nice cup of coffee that I will enjoy over and over again.

San Diego tap water smells a bit and leaves a lot of white crud in the glass if evaporated dry. But, what the hey? Why should I buy supplemental minerals if Colorado River water already contains a good variety? In any case, the city says it's safe and I know of no problems. Well, my wife feels differently about such matters. She's from Europe and nobody there supposedly drinks tap water. Disgusting. Drinking water must come in a bottle and be collected from some important and well-known springs. Besides, she seems to have elevated senses in taste, smell, sight, hearing and all other senses. In any case, to keep peace in the household, I agreed that we would drink bottled water. We gradually settled in on Kirkland Signature bottled water. The price was right! Well, now even that isn't good enough. My wife seems to have discovered Fiji Natural Artesian Water which comes in attractive rectangular bottles and is imported all the way from the South Pacific. It costs several times as much as regular brands, but that's part of the appeal. It's the best, she claims. It's so smooth and goes down so easy, she says. Now other bottled waters, although OK, are not nearly as good. No, Fiji Natural Artesian Water is the water for her. I must admit that it's excellent, but the cost is way too high.

Gary Peterson

Pure Naturala describe their product as "gluten free, vegan, kosher and absolutely delicious." The first three may be, but the taste is okay but nothing special. Maybe my sweet tooth is getting in the way, but delicious is not a word that I would use to describe the product.

Please dont get me wrong. These bars don't taste bad. It's just that, as a snack, they don't have that "hit it out of the park taste." I expected a bit more taste than the product offered.

This is a very good tasting granola. The almonds in the "banana nut" flavor are very hard, so if this is not a problem go for it and try it out! The cost is high for such a small amount of granola and it doesn't last long even buying it in bulk packages of pack of six in 12 ounce packs. It's all natural which is good, but for the cost I think it would be worth the time to buy the ingredients yourself to save some money.

i don't know how the last reviewer got that this is all pepper... the ingredient of pepper is WAY down on the list of ingredients.

i always find myself craving something savory as a snack, and to stop myself from grabbing more chips or chex mix from the office pantry, i like to make a little cup of this soup to satiate me.

i think it's a perfect mix of hot and sour. it's not much else, hot and sour soups in general is just broth that hot and sour (plus veggies and meat that u won't find here). it satisfies my craving and is only 20 calories.

the amazon price is kinda steep... even regular grocery stores have cheaper prices for single packs.
Bought this to add something tasty to the dry food so I only use a tablespoon or two with each meal. How can I take up 20 words with that said unless I write this!

Great breakfast tea, not as strong as some of the Twinings breakfast, but not as bitter, either.  Seems to make good tea at lower water temperatures compared to other black teas, which is good for me since the hot water tap on the office water cooler is not very hot.  Very economical in the large bags of loose leaf. I use a Swiss Gold infuser which does a good job on the fine cut teas like this one.
i have been buying kool-aid by the cases of 96 green apple in5s for $20.00. thats not kool. i would like to see some old flavovs come back. such as choc, cke and others.

Take it from an Italian, this is the best tuna and so glad I found it at Amazon. Can't find it anywhere in Las Vegas. The family had this shipped from NY to us because it's worth it.

Try it with pasta. Put some olive oil in a pan, sliced up garlic, red onions, and some tomato sauce. When the onion and garlic is translucent (don't let it burn), add a couple of tablespoons of sour cream, add the whole can of tuna (oil included), mix it all up and put it over your pasta...WOW!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Update: I found out that this tuna comes from Thailand. I used to think it came from Italy. The caution here is mercury. There are no government controlled food inspections in Thailand as there are in the US, so you may be taking a chance with mercury poisoning. I'm very disappointed and will not order again...

I was hoping I found a source for "real" grits. I was tipped off that this wasn't the real deal when the label said something about "mush". It fits the definition of mush i.e. soft or soggy mass.

I have been searching for real grits since my supplier retired. He refurbished an old grist mill as a hobby then decided to use the plentiful local corn to mill grits. They were fabulous, the real kind that you had to add water, let the hulls float to the top, pour off the water, add more water, then cook for 45 minutes. Lots of butter, salt, and pepper and there's nothing better.

I find that this is nice and filling and, being an Amy's product, gives me greater peace of mind about quality ingredients.

However, let's be honest--this is still a rather bland chili offering. And I don't mean bland in the spicy-level way. I mean bland in the flavor way.

YET..it's a very, very good base to customize. You got the nice ingredients, the plentiful beans, the tofu for protein (if you don't mind that). I add tomatoes, peppers, onions, and hot sauce or some sort of salsa, plus onion powder, to give it more flavor and texture. I will add some organic or low-fat shredded Mexican or cheddar on top for fun, too. I find once I tweak it, I really like it for lunch with some brown rice or organic tortillas.

It works very nicely in a layer dip with chips, too.

I appreciate the lower sodium levels, as I have high BP.

I recommend this if you don't mind customizing your canned chili. Or, if you're used to bland canned food, then it could suit you "as is" from the can.

Either way, if you're looking for a convenience food that's as wholesome as prepackaged stuff of this sort can be, this is a good bet. Give it a try. Play with it. It might become a staple for you.

And if you like canned convenience foods, try Amy's Low-Sodium cream of tomato soup. I find that one very nice--comfort food. (The cream of mushroom is nice if you add more of your own fresh organic mushrooms and some spices--garlic powder, onion powder, a pinch of thyme, black pepper, otherwise it also is rather bland.)

Enjoy.

Mir

As far as taste goes, they all come running when they hear me opening the package.  I can't vouch for the teeth cleaning properties, as it appeared to me they were mostly swallowing them after a couple of bites.  I keep snacks to a minimum to prevent obesity.  What we need is a flavorful chew for cats they could mouth real well.  I have a couple that would chew them, cleaning their teeth without a lot of calories.

This sea salt did not work well in the MIU Salt Mill.  No matter how I adjusted the mill, the salt 'stuck' and clogged up the mill grinder.  It appears to be too 'wet' or 'sticky' to grind properly - at least in the MIU mill.

About half the cans in my case were dented, and it certainly looks to me that they must have been dented before being packaged together into my case (cans in the middle of the pack have side dents, for example).  I had intended to include a can or two into care packages destined for American soldiers (a little taste of Thanksgiving, and the cans are pretty enough to be decorative).  But, I can't be sending dented cans to our troops -- and I don't want to eat from dented cans myself, so I'm vexed.  For purposes of this review, I opened a good can to taste the product, and the product tastes good.  It certainly costs enough.  I would have been quite happy with this if I didn't find half the goods were damaged (I consider them unusable), and I didn't think that I was intentionally bamboozled by someone trying to dump dented cans.

I had actually had one or two of these cookies at a picnic a few weeks back. I was fairly impressed at how good they were and was eager to try them again.  Unfortunately, the pack that I received from Amazon was less than impressive. The cookies themselves were dark, seemingly burned. Half of the pack was broken. And honestly, they just didn't live up to my memory of just a few weeks earlier. I'd be willing to give the cookies one more swing, based on my first exposure.  Because, to be certain, if this pack of Chips Ahoy Gooey were my first go round...  there wouldn't be a second.
The best review I can give is that my girlfriend and her roommates annihilated these within a couple days of getting the package.
This coffee isn't sold in Canada and my daughter loves it, so I buy it as a treat for her.

Delicious, quick, easy & convenient! Not as happy with the texture as with the white sticky rice though. Guess it being sprouted brown rice makes it a little more grainy/tougher texture but overall good flavor so Im not complaining :)

If you like Crystal Light Lemonade, you'll probably like this.

The sweet, artificially sweet, too sweet flavor of tart lime hits you when you take a drink. In about three gulps, the artificial sweetner aftertaste subsides and it is pretty refreshing. I like to mix mine in a quart sized bottle of water - so the taste doesn't overpower me when I'm thirsty. I also tried with a lick of salt on my glass, but didn't like the flavor mixture. No, this doesn't taste like a primium margarita.... but it is tart and tangy.

Now for the bad part.... when mixed properly, this substance makes water turn cloudy pea green. Rather a bright pea green.. but certainly not the color of any margarita I've been served. I prefer to drink this in a sealed travel mug just so I don't have to look at the color.

Have only tried about 3 of the flavored coffees thus far and not impressed at all...  The coffees are weak and lack the flavor that they should have such as the Cinnamon Roll coffee - coffee was very weak and cinnamon roll flavor non-existent. Will continue to try more but not hopeful at the moment...

The Roland Original Israeli Couscous was not the same as I have previously ordered. The size of each piece of toasted pasta was half the size of the real "original". Instead of pearl pasta it is closer to standard couscous. I was disappointed with this aspect of my purchase and will look for another manufacturer.

I was glad to find this sampler so I could try the Starbucks k-cups without committing to a large supply. Not suitable for gift giving as it's a plain box with k-cups jumbled in.

1 - French Roast my favorite, bold, strong flavorful.
2 - Pike Place Roast - surprise for me since it's medium roast. Flavorful.

4 - Breakfast blend - weak and bland

I canceled my ship and save on this item. The package costs more than the local grocery store, per item. And it's smaller in weight than the local store's product. I was also surprised that the noodles are clear. But in the picture, they do look clear. The local product contains tofu to give it a more noodle-like look (and more calories).

So all of that to the side, I do think this flavor of shirataki noodles are less smelly than other varieties I've tried. And they taste like the others, which pretty much means no taste. But they do give you somewhat the experience of eating a noodle while really saving on calories. As with all shirataki noodles, they're a tad bit slimey and can be a little bit hard to eat at first.

To use this product, I rinse it very well in a collander, trying not to smell it as it comes out of the package. Then I heat them in the microwave 2-3 minutes to warm them up. Rinse that water off. Top with other things, like steamed Asian mixed vegetables. I toss them in a little curry as well.

I love olives, but these are not up to par. There is an aftertaste, perhaps due to the added chemicals?

The juice, however, is wonderful, so be sure to save it for a drink--I like it as is, but it would be great in a dirty martini*.

It was difficult to discern any anchovy taste (or texture), but these are quite passable with a dollop of cream cheese. It seems to cut the aftertaste.

Wish I liked them more, I really wanted to...but had I seen the ingredient list, I wouldn't have bought them.

If you love green olives and anchovies, buy some of each and stuff them yourself.

*If you're stuck with most of the 12-pack, throw a martini party, one can per drink :) Let them add their olive juice and olives. If they like olives, after the martini they will eat them :)

I bought this tea b/c I assumed is was similar to the organic 40 count box that I buy in the super market. Well these tea bags contain half the tea. The quality of tea is not even the same b/c I used 2 bags inside of the usual 1. The instruction say to put the bag in a tea cup, add boiling water and steep for 3-4 minutes. The tea cup they refer to is probably
What you get in a Chinese restaurant. I will not buy this again
This is the best tea I've tried. Best price for a bulk tea also. Rich taste and color. Love it!
The product was shipped out and received very quickly.  The candy was fresh and good quality.

To be honest, it looks like something that came out of a dog. Fortunately, it tastes much better than it looks. It's greasy. You will want rice with it, or bread, or something to soak up the oil.

It's surprisingly high in calcium, which is good. It's unsurprisingly high in fats and salt but, hey, live a little. It's not seriously spicy but, it made me feel right warm after a package ("2.5 servings" or 550 Calories).

Good emergency food. It's palatable, it will last a long time without refrigeration, and it can be quickly and simply prepared in a variety of ways.

I am from Trinidad in the Caribbean and ordered this item thru my skybox. After reading all the negative reviews, I was a bit skeptical about ordering a variety pack.  I still decided to order this one in particular and (so far) it turned out pretty decent! I have 35 completely different flavours including the Apple Cider, Pumpkin Spice, Iced Coffees etc. I just received my shipment today in acceptable packaging , haven't tried any of them a yet so this review is positive up to this point. Let's hope when I actually start to use the k-cups, I will not regret this positive review.

It's Kool-Aid! It's peach mango flavored, and it tastes great! Since it's already sweetened, you just add water, stir, and start pouring. If it was just me, I'd use slightly less than the recommended amount for 2 quarts, since I find it to be a little bit sweet. But for my girls, even at the recommended amount, my 6 year old determined that it was missing just a little bit of sugar, and that with that added sugar it would be perfect.

We don't drink this often, but it's great for a treat every so often. And since it's premixed, my girls could actually make it themselves.

This packaging is boxed as displayed (the plastic bags are not put in burlap bags as they do with most of their other product offers which would have offered another barrier to mixing of different items). Several of the plastic bags were split open when I received them, resulting in the contents of several different products being mixed together into a big mess.
